links.outcome: Model accuracy on chest X-rays under adversarial attacks (FGSM, AutoAttack)
links.effect: All models experienced a decrease in accuracy after adversarial attacks; MobileNet was more robust than the other CNN-based models. Exact figures are not reported in the abstract.
links.quote: Our findings indicate that while all models experienced a decrease in accuracy after adversarial attacks, MobileNet consistently demonstrated superior robustness compared to other CNN-based models.

unlisted_practices: Inverse robustness training to improve model stability against adversarial attacks
Choosing sparser model architectures (MobileNet) for adversarial robustness

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the vulnerability of chest X-ray deep learning models to adversarial attacks and tests adversarial/inverse robustness training as a safeguard to improve model stability and security.
